title: BOSH Job Spec
description:
Job Spec for BOSH Releases.

Docs: https://bosh.io/docs/jobs/

packages.description: Package dependencies required by the job at runtime.

Templates.description: Template files found in the templates directory of the job without the `.erb` suffix (keys of the Hash) and their final destinations (values of the Hash), relative to the job directory on the deployed VMs.

Consumes.description: Links that are consumed by the job for rendering ERB templates.

name.description: Name of the link to find.

type.description:
Type of the link to be found.

Common link types: https://bosh.io/docs/links-common-types/

optional.description: Whether finding an matching link is optional

Provides.description: Links that are exposed to other jobs for rendering their ERB templates.

properties.description: List of property keys in dot notation

Properties.description: Configuration options supported by the job.

description.description: Describes purpose of the property. This is not used by the Director, but is displayed in job configuration details provided by the [release index](https://bosh.io/releases/).

type.description: The type of the property. This is only a convention for release authors to provide a type when they estimate it useful

example.description: Example value to be displayed in the [release index](https://bosh.io/releases/).

default.description: The default value for the property.
